remoteTools.title: Install required tools
remoteTools.confirm: Server {target} needs {tools}. Install using {manager} and continue?
remoteTools.notice: Packages come from the server's configured repositories. Installation may take a few minutes. Your authentication password is used only for this installation and is not saved.

errors.invalid_input: Invalid installation parameters or password format.
errors.unauthenticated: Your login has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.host_key_untrusted: The server host key is not trusted. Connect to the server and verify its fingerprint first.
errors.stale_plan: The server or installation plan has changed. Start the operation again.
errors.conflict: Another server operation is active or awaiting confirmation. Try again later.
errors.unsupported: Required tools are missing and no supported package manager or privilege method is available. Install them manually.
errors.authentication_failed: sudo authentication or permission was denied. Check the password and sudo configuration.
errors.installation_failed: Installation failed or tools are still unavailable. Check the server's repositories and package manager.
errors.connection_unavailable: The server could not be reached. Check its address and network connection.
errors.unavailable: Unable to check or install remote tools. Check the connection.
errors.operation_unknown: The installation result is unconfirmed. Check the server before attempting another installation.
errors.limit_exceeded: Too many tool requests. Please try again later.
errors.shutting_down: The service is stopping. Please try again later.
errors.protocol_failure: Invalid tool detection response. Refresh and try again.
